title: Hate Trumps Love: The Impact of Political Polarization on Social Preferences
eligible_reason: No panel DiD. Five preregistered online behavioral experiments (dictator and public goods games) on political polarization; between-subject OLS of giving/contribution on matched-same-kind and hate x matched interactions, robust SEs. The 'difference-in-difference approach' in the text contrasts Trump-identity with painter-preference (Klee/Kandinsky) identity groups, not a staggered policy adoption.
design_notes: Do-files per study (1a-1e DG, 2a-2d PGG, 3 Norms): reg DG_decision_perc matched_same_kind [closeness_perc] [$controls], robust; reg ... own_hate_new##matched_new.
